summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing Exhibit 99.1, its routine monthly unaudited bitcoin production and mining operations update for September 2026, signed by Chairman/CEO Nangeng Zhang. Operations: non-JV installed hashrate steady at 10 EH/s; 44 BTC mined in the month; treasury 1,875 BTC; JV (49% Alborz, Bear, Chief Mountain, West Texas) installed 4.87 EH/s and operating 4.18 EH/s; average all-in power cost $0.043/kWh; 8 MW Nordic district-heating project operational. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate-action terms are stated; this is an ordinary operational disclosure, not a special situation.
